# Draftly

> Draftly is an assignment workspace for higher education — students do the work individually or together in a tracked, Word-styled editor, and lecturers review how the work developed from first draft to final submission. Realtime group editing runs on one shared document per group (Yjs + Hocuspocus) with per-member contribution tracking.

## Overview
- Product site: [/](/)
- Source of truth for proof-of-work: `collab_attribution` + sealed server snapshot at submit, surfaced in playback + verdict
- Stack: React + TipTap/Yjs, Node API (port 8001), Analyzer (8002), Collab/Hocuspocus (8003/8004/8005)

## For students
- Individual assignments are written in a tracked Word-styled TipTap editor; every keystroke/paste/edit is captured via a realtime WebSocket stream
- Group assignments: the whole group edits ONE shared sectioned document; members create/name/reorder sections; leader submits when all are Done (or overrides with a reason); submission seals a server-side snapshot
- Dashboard, course hub, and group work pages are authenticated: [/dashboard](/dashboard), [/courses/:id](/courses/:id), [/assignments/:id](/assignments/:id), [/group/:id](/group/:id)

## For lecturers
- Assignment CRUD and roster: [/assignments/:id](/assignments/:id) (owner sees groups), [/assignments/:id/groups](/assignments/:id/groups)
- Review & integrity: [/review/:id](/review/:id) (playback, insights, originality verdict bound to the sealed snapshot)
- Verdict engine: stateless analyzer at `POST /api/submissions/:id/verdict` (five evidence-weighted factors, continuous curves, no caps)

## API
- Auth: `POST /api/register`, `POST /api/login` (HS256 JWT, 7-day expiry) — see [AGENTS.md](/AGENTS.md) and `docs/superpowers/plans/api-route-contract.md` when present
- Docs & contract: see repository `README.md`, `DESIGN.md`, `PRODUCT.md`

## Legal & preferences
- Privacy choices and cookie preferences are managed in-app; see [Privacy](/privacy) and [Cookie Policy](/cookies)
- Robots: [/robots.txt](/robots.txt) · Sitemap: [/sitemap.xml](/sitemap.xml) · Manifest: [/manifest.webmanifest](/manifest.webmanifest)

## Notes for AI agents
- Do not attempt to crawl authenticated routes without a valid `Authorization: Bearer <jwt>` header
- `POST /api/events` (HTTP fallback) and the tracking WebSocket (`/track?token=<jwt>`) accept event batches for `submission_id`
- Canonical URLs are relative (e.g. `/login`); resolve against the site origin at request time — no domain is hardcoded in `sitemap.xml` or `llms.txt` by design
